US bill could impose 100% tariff on Indian goods over Russian oil imports

A new amendment to a US sanctions bill could lead to a 100% tariff on Indian goods if India continues to import oil from Russia. The US Russia Sanctions Act, as amended, specifically names India in relation to its oil purchases from Russia. This potential tariff could significantly impact India's trade relationship with the United States.
